title: One spiking expert with logical threshold specialists
scope: Synthetic CPU mechanism screen for whether threshold views can share one spiking synapse pool and where private synapse state becomes necessary.
hypothesis: A shared spiking synapse vector plus a small task-role threshold coordinate will recover independent-expert quality on tasks sharing synaptic structure at lower actual payload bytes; on generic task-specific synapses, threshold-only views will fail and rank-limited private synapse residuals will reveal the sharing boundary.

teacher_families.shared_synapse_threshold: Eight binary tasks share one teacher synaptic vector and vary only task threshold.
teacher_families.generic_task_synapses: Eight binary tasks use independently sampled teacher synaptic vectors and thresholds.

data.input: iid standard-normal 16D observations with explicit observed task role id
data.teacher_labels: hard one-neuron threshold spike sign; role identity available to every method
data.split: independent examples per role and world; fresh worlds use new teacher weights and samples

controls: one physical synapse vector and one shared threshold
one shared synapse vector plus ordinary direct per-role threshold table
one shared synapse vector plus Mirror base/scale/role-coordinate threshold generator
shared synapse plus rank-2 role-specific synapse residual and direct threshold table
eight independent routed SNN experts with one active expert per role

model.physical_object: one 16-input synapse vector feeding a hard-threshold single-step spiking neuron
model.training: AdamW with sigmoid surrogate logits at train time; hard spike sign at inference; up to 300 epochs, early stopping on development accuracy with patience 15
model.router: role id is observable and identical across methods; expert route is deterministic top-1 identity lookup, whose mapping is charged in serialized metadata

paid_objects: all threshold parameters or Mirror base/scale/role codes

success_gate: On shared_synapse_threshold fresh worlds, Mirror is within 1 percentage point of independent, uses <=80% of independent bytes, and improves >=2 points over the ordinary direct threshold-bank control at comparable active MACs. Generic family is reported separately and must state where private synapses restore quality.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any quality/byte gate or exactly aliases the direct threshold bank without a better quality/storage/compute frontier.
boundaries: Synthetic one-neuron threshold task only; no natural SNN, event dataset, or MoE benchmark claim.
Spike count is a simulator output, not hardware energy.
Three fresh worlds are required for this scoped screen.
Role identity is supplied to all controls; no task inference/generalization claim.
Rank-2 residual is a simple private-state control, not a full search over ranks.
